actual_scope: Prove that for every certified odd kernel q in {1,3,5,7,9,15} and every nonempty J subset {0..5}, the signed q-dyadic run walk attains children 2r+c / affine 6(2r+c) / XOR 2r on odd moduli coprime to q (vs 3r/18r/2r separate #2687 pairs), matching the dyadic-run formula with no typed gain over q=1; inherit the restricted-alphabet 2r+c lower bound with q-dyadic edges.
scope_change_reason: BIT-supplier hosting for #2687 OQ1 cannot finish cleanly in budget without a non-cancellable admitted source-return/routing/precision/dispatch boundary (prior soft-overlap deferred). Redirect to a disjoint #840-style construction: lift PR953 dyadic-run batching through the #2687 odd-kernel admission pattern.
bottleneck_link: Single-pair odd-kernel invoices match dyadic typed counts; batching consecutive q-dyadic indices is the natural #840-lineage saving still open after #2687, and must charge the same excluded-prime domain.
stop_rule: Stop after multi-kernel run invoices on all 63 subsets, admission probes, tap/component checks, independent rebuild and package controls. No supplier hosting search, no coeff-bit tariff retarget, no new kappa.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 63 subsets × 6 kernels, seed-55 15→12/90→72/10, admission probes, rational/modular columns; independent.py rebuilds walk and pattern; test_package.py corruption controls.
